strings.name: Denis Villeneuve
strings.summary: Villeneuve began in Quebec’s French-language cinema, reaching wider audiences with Incendies before Prisoners and Sicario. Arrival, Blade Runner 2049 and Dune developed contemplative, large-scale science fiction concerned with language, memory and power. At November 13,2026, Dune: Part Three had not opened; the next Bond film remained a subsequent project.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Through Arrival and Dune, he brought philosophical and political questions into big-budget science fiction, combining personal authorship with genre storytelling.
